analysisFile.description: path the full prose analysis was written to

invariants.description: What must hold. Each cites a line.

assumptions.description: What this function takes on faith, including anything a callee is relied on to enforce.

establishedBy.description: the function or line that establishes it, or "nothing found" if unestablished

propagates.description: what the callee establishes or assumes that the caller then depends on

openQuestions.description: Unresolved items, phrased as "unclear; need to inspect X". Empty is a valid answer.

params.prizeToken is an honest, standards-compliant ERC-721 contract that maintains exclusive custody of params.prizeTokenId in raffle after ownerOf(params.prizeTokenId) == raffle succeeds at creation and permits later transferFrom in redeemWinningTicket or releaseSponsorPrize
assumptions.establishedBy: nothing found (RaffleFactory.sol:L155, L171-L177, L128-L134 and Raffle.sol:L416-L431 enforce only code presence, ERC-165 IERC721 response, onERC721Received callback, and immediate post-transfer ownerOf == raffle)

assumptions.claim: params.sponsorRecipient can receive quoteToken via SafeERC20.safeTransfer and params.prizeToken via IERC721.transferFrom without token-level blacklisting or revert
assumptions.establishedBy: nothing found (RaffleFactory.sol:L156, L163-L169 and Raffle.sol:L182, L193-L195 enforce only non-zero and non-protocol-sink addresses)

assumptions.claim: params.prizeToken does not invoke raffle.buyEntries during safeTransferFrom after calling raffle.onERC721Received before RaffleCreated is emitted
assumptions.establishedBy: nothing found (RaffleFactory.sol:L132-L134 enforces IRaffle(raffle).status() == Status.Active, which reverts if enableRefunds was called, but buyEntries keeps status == Status.Active)

callers: External entrypoint (any prospective sponsor address via createRaffle at packages/contracts/src/RaffleFactory.sol:L97); no internal callers

calls.propagates: Reverts with ReentrancyGuardReentrantCall if REENTRANCY_GUARD_STORAGE == ENTERED, locks factory against reentrant createRaffle calls across external calls (ReentrancyGuard.sol:L69-L73, L88-L106)

Establishes params.prizeToken.code.length > 0, params.sponsorRecipient != address(0), neither prizeToken nor sponsorRecipient is factory/quoteToken/vrfWrapper/raffleImplementation/existing isRaffle, sponsorRecipient != prizeToken, IERC165(prizeToken).supportsInterface(IERC721) == true, and params.reserveEntries > 0; does not check msg.sender, endTime, or sponsorRecipient == new raffle clone (RaffleFactory.sol:L154-L185)

Deploys a 45-byte ERC-1167 minimal proxy delegating to raffleImplementation via CREATE and reverts with Errors.FailedDeployment if address(0); does not check raffleImplementation.code.length > 0 (Clones.sol:L32-L62)

Enforces one-time initialization by factory, screens sponsor (msg.sender), protocolTreasury, and sponsorRecipient against address(0), the new clone itself (address(this)), factory, quoteToken, i_vrfV2PlusWrapper, prizeToken, raffleImplementation, and existing isRaffle entries, writes clone config, and sets status = Status.AwaitingPrize; relies on caller for reserveEntries > 0 and endTime bounds (Raffle.sol:L176-L206, L593-L605)

Untrusted external call expected to transfer params.prizeTokenId from msg.sender to raffle and invoke raffle.onERC721Received(address(this), msg.sender, params.prizeTokenId, ""); may execute arbitrary external calls including calling into the newly active raffle clone before returning (RaffleFactory.sol:L128)

Invoked by params.prizeToken during safeTransferFrom; enforces status == Status.AwaitingPrize, msg.sender == address(prizeToken), tokenId == prizeTokenId, from == sponsor, and operator == factory, transitions status to Status.Active, and emits PrizeDeposited (Raffle.sol:L416-L431)
Untrusted STATICCALL checked at L129-L131 to equal raffle; does not guarantee persistent custody on an arbitrary contract (RaffleFactory.sol:L129)

STATICCALL to the clone checked at L132-L134 to equal IRaffle.Status.Active, proving onERC721Received ran and status was not transitioned away from Active during safeTransferFrom (RaffleFactory.sol:L132, Raffle.sol:L124)

invariants.claim: Every created raffle has 1 <= reserveEntries <= type(uint128).max and creation block.timestamp < endTime <= block.timestamp + 30 days
raffleCount increments sequentially from 1 and raffleById, idByRaffle, and isRaffle form a 1-to-1 registry of deployed ERC-1167 clones written before prize.safeTransferFrom executes

Neither prizeToken, sponsor, sponsorRecipient, nor protocolTreasury equals the new raffle clone, RaffleFactory, quoteToken, vrfWrapper, raffleImplementation, or any registered raffle in isRaffle, and sponsor, sponsorRecipient, and protocolTreasury do not equal prizeToken
createRaffle returns only if prize.ownerOf(params.prizeTokenId) == raffle and IRaffle(raffle).status() == IRaffle.Status.Active after prize.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, raffle, params.prizeTokenId)

sharedState: RaffleFactory.raffleCount, RaffleFactory.raffleById, RaffleFactory.idByRaffle (written at RaffleFactory.sol:L105, L123-L124)
RaffleFactory.isRaffle (written at RaffleFactory.sol:L125; read by RaffleFactory._validateCreateParams at L159, L166 and Raffle._isProtocolDestination at Raffle.sol:L603)

Raffle clone storage: initialized, sponsor, sponsorRecipient, protocolTreasury, prizeToken, prizeTokenId, raffleId, reserveEntries, endTime, status (written via Raffle.initialize at Raffle.sol:L179, L197-L205 and Raffle.onERC721Received at Raffle.sol:L428; read across Raffle.sol)
